# DATA PROCESSING TERMS — Calder Data Services, Inc.

These Terms apply to Processing carried out by Calder Data Services, Inc.
("Calder") for the customer identified in the Order ("Client").

## 1. Scope and Roles

1.1 Client determines the purposes and means of Processing. Calder Processes
on Client's behalf.

## 2. Use of Data

2.1 Calder Processes Client Personal Data to provide the Services.

2.2 Calder may analyze service usage and performance data to operate,
maintain, and improve the Services generally. Nothing in this section
permits Calder to disclose Client Personal Data to third parties.

## 3. Subprocessors

3.1 Calder maintains a list of Subprocessors on its website and may update
it from time to time.

## 4. Security

4.1 Calder implements appropriate technical and organisational measures
having regard to the state of the art and the costs of implementation.

## 5. Incidents

5.1 Calder shall inform Client of any confirmed Personal Data Breach
promptly following Calder's determination that a breach has occurred.

## 6. Transfers

6.1 Client acknowledges that Processing may occur in any country in which
Calder or its Subprocessors operate.

## 7. Term

7.1 On expiry Calder will delete Client Personal Data in accordance with its
retention schedule.
